description_short.value: Ghanaian universal bank with a mortgage heritage, two-thirds owned by Trinidad and Tobago's Republic Financial Holdings, with brokerage, asset management and pension subsidiaries.
description_short.source: Written by us from the Republic Bank (Ghana) PLC 2025 Annual Report (report of the directors: principal activities, holding company, subsidiaries)

description_full.value: Republic Bank (Ghana) PLC is a universal bank that also provides residential and commercial mortgages, investment banking, custody and pension services. It began as Home Finance Company Limited and was incorporated on 7 May 1990. Republic Financial Holdings Limited of Trinidad and Tobago owns 66.54% of its shares, and Ghana's Social Security and National Insurance Trust (SSNIT) a further 25.87%. Its subsidiaries include Republic Investments (Ghana) for fund and asset management, Republic Securities for brokerage, Republic Trust for pension administration and HFC Realty for mortgages. At the end of 2025 it had 39 branches in 11 of Ghana's 16 regions, and its head office is Republic Court on Independence Avenue, Accra. It has been listed on the Ghana Stock Exchange since 5 October 1994. The Bank of Ghana declined its proposed 2021 dividend, and it made a loss in 2022 after the domestic debt exchange. It returned to profit in 2023 and paid a dividend again for 2025.
